course.name: Six Figure Capital
course.tagline: Video-based forex, commodities and crypto trading education built around harmonic pattern analysis.
course.about: Six Figure Capital is a trading education platform run by Lewis Glasgow, teaching forex, commodities and cryptocurrency trading through harmonic pattern analysis. It's built as two video courses plus community access and downloadable resources, aimed at beginner-to-advanced traders.

curriculum.title: 14-Day Foundation Course
topics: Core trading fundamentals and forex basics
Currency pairs, trading sessions and market terminology
Chart analysis and the TradingView platform
Harmonic patterns: Bat, Gartley, Butterfly, Crab

curriculum.title: Harmonic Mastery Course
topics: Trade management systems (marked "coming soon" on the provider's site)
Pattern violations and timeframe analysis (marked "coming soon" on the provider's site)

formats.label: Video lessons
formats.description: 32 instructional videos across the two courses (19 in the Foundation course, 13 in Harmonic Mastery).

formats.label: Downloadable resources
formats.description: Breakthrough guide, currency cheat sheet, trading journal templates, harmonic trading guides and a compound interest calculator.

formats.label: Community access
formats.description: Access to the Six Figure Capital community, included with membership.

formats.label: Ongoing support & updates
formats.description: Lifetime access to course updates and provider support.

pricing.name: 12-Month Contract
pricing.billing_note: 12 monthly payments (£1,164 total); financing via Klarna, Clearpay or PayPal Credit

pricing.name: Lifetime Membership
pricing.billing_note: One-time payment; financing via Klarna, Clearpay or PayPal Credit

course.refund_policy: No money-back guarantee or refund policy is stated on the provider's website (last checked when this listing was built).
